technical_and_design_decisions: Establish a dedicated module structure within the Spring XD repository for Admin SPI implementations and abstractions.
Define a unified Module Registry abstraction interface supporting SPI calls like `getStatus()`, `listModules()`, and status mapping.
Implement Receptor Admin SPI using Lattice/Receptor REST/Java client APIs to map container instance state to ModuleStatus.
Implement CloudController Admin SPI using Cloud Foundry Java Client API to query application deployment status and health metrics.
Use Spring Framework `@Profile` conditional auto-configuration to automatically wire the appropriate SPI implementation based on active environment profiles (e.g., `cloud`, `lattice`, `local`).
Integrate Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka for module self-registration, leveraging Eureka metadata maps to store custom module descriptors and state metadata.
Implement custom Eureka filter and search capabilities to allow module discovery by explicit module name in addition to `spring.application.name`.
assumptions: Development assumes the use of Java 17 and Spring Framework 6.0 compatibility as noted in the base specification.
Target APIs (Receptor REST API, Cloud Foundry CloudController API, Eureka Server) are accessible or mockable during local integration testing.
Existing Spring XD core classes (like `ModuleDescriptor` and `ModuleStatus`) are available as dependency abstractions.
Effort includes unit testing, integration testing using mocked API endpoints, and technical documentation.

activities.activity_description: Create permanent package/module location for SPI implementations (U3) and build the initial `ModuleRegistry` abstraction interfaces and common data structures (U4).
Implement the Admin SPI using Receptor client API to query module deployment status, health metrics, and active instance listings (U1).
Implement the Admin SPI using Cloud Foundry CloudController API to fetch application status, metrics, and module mappings (U2).
Configure profile-aware Spring auto-configuration to dynamically bind Receptor, CloudController, or local implementations based on runtime profiles (U5).
Implement module self-registration upon installation with Eureka, storing module state and specification metadata within Eureka instance metadata (U6, U8).

activities.activity_name: Custom Module Search by Name in Eureka
activities.activity_description: Add support for searching and retrieving modules by custom module name in Eureka beyond default `spring.application.name` (U7).
Develop unit tests, integration tests with API mocks, and verify profile-driven bean initialization across Cloud Foundry, Lattice, and standalone environments.
